A few rules that matter here:
- Working hours are Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, and official events are fixed: a cancellation or move counts only when the department office (me) confirms it in writing.
- A TA makes time for their course's staff meetings — they go into free time, not over your lectures, sections or office hours.
- The professor's teaching and governance duties come before meetings with students, so the slot has to be in their free time too.
- A meeting is booked only when every participant has it on their calendar, and every change should be logged.

I don't keep anyone's private appointments, and I don't share anyone's whereabouts. Tell me the slot you're considering and I can check it against the official schedule.
